fields.Name: T132 - Admin Applications Management
fields.Description: Verifies the Admin app's Identity & Access > Apps sub-section renders the application management grid without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Admin app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). Open the 'Identity & Access' section, then in its left sub-navigation click the 'Apps' sub-section. The success state is a grid of application records displayed in the main panel. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained env - wait for the grid to populate, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Admin app is active with the Identity & Access section open and the Apps sub-section selected in the left sub-navigation
The application management grid renders in the main panel showing multiple application rows
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
